facts.fact: Cursor's Free plan is listed at $0/month on the pricing page.
The Plus plan is listed at $8/month and is described as the introductory plan.
The Premium plan is listed at $30/month and is marked as the most popular plan.
The Super plan is listed at $100/month.
The Ultra plan is listed at $200/month.
The vendor states the Premium plan provides 4x more usage compared to Plus.
The vendor states the Super plan provides 15x more usage compared to Plus.
The vendor states the Ultra plan provides 50x more usage compared to Plus.
The Teams plan is listed at $30 or more per user per month.
The Teams plan's usage is listed as 4-50x Plus.
facts.quote: | Usage | Limited | Basic | 4x Plus | 15x Plus | 50x Plus | 4-50x Plus | Pooled |

facts.fact: The Enterprise plan has custom pricing and is sold through sales contact.
The vendor states that prices shown do not include applicable taxes or fees such as VAT.
facts.quote: Prices shown do not include applicable taxes or fees (e.g. VAT).

facts.fact: The vendor states third-party model usage in Cursor is not included in the monthly prices and must be purchased separately.
facts.quote: Third Party model usage in Cursor is not included in the monthly prices shown and must be purchased separately.

facts.fact: The vendor states subscribers must cancel at least 24 hours prior to renewal to avoid additional charges.
facts.quote: [Cancel anytime](https://x.ai/legal/bundled-subscription-terms#cancel), at least 24 hours prior to renewal to avoid additional charges.

facts.fact: The vendor states prices are subject to change.
The vendor lists X Money APY of 6.00% with Direct Deposit on the Free and Plus plans.
